#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;
long long dp[1010];

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    dp[0] = 1;
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int j = i; j <= n; ++j) {
            if ((i + j) % 2 == 1) {
                ans = (ans + dp[j]) % MOD;
            }
            dp[j + 1] = (dp[j + 1] + dp[j]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
